en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get our bodies moving
Let's clean up a little
I'm tired...
...What?

M-Moving our bodies in the g-gym...
Y-You don't mean...THAT, do you?

M-Move our bodies...into the gym storage
room...and see where things go...?

Y-You have quite the imagination...
For a virgin, that is...
<CLT=cltMIND>What is going on in that head of hers?
Huh? Why do I gotta help you clean?

If you wanna clean something so badly, how
'bout you clean that tiny dick of yours!

No matter how many times you wash it,
it's never gonna get any bigger!

Eh!? W-Were you gonna just collapse and
hope that <CLT=cltSTRONG>one thing led to another<CLT=cltNORMAL>...?

E-Even with all my experience...you can't
just suddenly spring that on me!
<CLT=cltMIND>Uh oh, she's not getting it...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
